overheat.label: Arcane Overheat
overheat.reminder: When a mage casts magic, the Spell Intensity they choose equals the amount of Arcane Overheat that builds up within them. A higher Arcane Overheat results in increasing penalties.

smolderingReminder.1: Every time the mage casts a spell, their Ob is always increased by +1. Less than 2 hits causes a Spell-Backfire.
smolderingReminder.2: All spells are super-charged, with an automatic and free +1 SI.

broilingReminder.1: The Ob for all tests is always increased by +1. Less than 3 hits causes a Spell-Backfire.
broilingReminder.2: All spells are super-charged, with an automatic and free +2 SI.

consumingReminder.1: 1D8 + 2 Pure damage every Tick. At the end of every tick, reduces Arcane Slag and Arcane Overheat by -1 point, each.
consumingReminder.2: The Ob for all tests is always increased by +2. Less than 4 hits causes a Spell-Backfire.
consumingReminder.3: All spells are super-charged, with an automatic and free +3 SI.

slag.label: Arcane Slag
slag.reminder:
When a mage casts magic, one third (RD and minimum 1) of the Spell Intensity they choose equals the amount of Arcane Slag that builds up within them. The other two thirds turn into Arcane Overheat.
1 point of Arcane Slag automatically leaves the character's body, every 6 hours. If that time is spent in active rest or meditation - that means doing nothing besides rest -, then 2 points leave the body, instead.
